content.title: Spend is fragmented across nine suppliers with no pricing power

paragraphs: Volume is split so thinly that no single supplier offers a volume discount, and three of the nine account for under 2% of spend each.

content.conclusion: Fragmentation is costing roughly four points of margin.
content.footnote: Source: FY25 procurement spend analysis; supplier master, accessed 2026.

content.title: Two suppliers would cover 80% of volume at better rates
content.conclusion: Consolidation lowers unit cost and shortens lead time.

content.title: Recommendation: consolidate to two preferred suppliers in H1
content.conclusion: Consolidation cuts cost and concentrates accountability without single-sourcing risk.

bullets: Award 80% of volume to Preferred A and B on 24-month terms.
Retain a thin long tail for resilience on specialty parts.
Target a four-point unit-cost reduction by year end.
